faq.a: Stock 305 is a clothing store in the Stockyard neighborhood of Vice City, confirmed as Ultimate Edition exclusive content. Rockstar calls it Stockyard's premiere destination for streetwear.

faq.q: What clothing does Stock 305 sell in GTA 6?
faq.a: Unique and exclusive looks not found in the Standard Edition, including patterned bandanas and tracksuits for Jason and a furry spotted coat for Lucia, according to Rockstar's description.

faq.q: Where is Stock 305 located in Vice City?
faq.a: It is located in the Stockyard neighborhood, the same area confirmed for the Electric Fang Tattoo parlor. The record describes Stockyard as a mural- and street-art-styled setting.

faq.q: Is Stock 305 available to Standard Edition owners?
faq.a: No. It is confirmed Ultimate Edition exclusive content, so its outfits are not found in the Standard Edition.

faq.q: Does Stock 305 sell the same items for Jason and Lucia?
faq.a: No, the outfits differ by character. Rockstar lists bandanas and tracksuits for Jason and a furry spotted coat for Lucia, rather than a shared item list.

notKnown: The full range of streetwear items beyond the bandanas, tracksuits and spotted coat named in the record.
Whether Stock 305 items can be worn during specific story missions or are purely cosmetic.
Whether the store connects to any mission content tied to the Stockyard area.
howWeKnow: Stock 305 was revealed on Rockstar's Official Site as part of its Ultimate Edition content breakdown, first shown on 24 June 2026 ahead of pre-orders opening on 25 June 2026. GameSpot reported the same details on 24 June 2026, which is the record's source and counts as major press coverage.
